# Error dictionary

spec_as_of 2026-10-13. Evidence: observed (seen on the live gateway), documented (in WhiteBooks docs), inferred (reasoned, unconfirmed).

## Any API (WhiteBooks gateway)

| Code | Meaning | Likely cause | Fix | Evidence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GSTN_API_ACCESS_DISABLED` | The taxpayer has not enabled, or has revoked, 'Manage API Access' on the GST portal for this GSP-ASP pair (symbolic code; the real GSTN code is not yet transcribed). | API access on the GST portal is off, expired (granted for 6 hours to 30 days) or revoked for this GSP-ASP pair. | Ask the taxpayer to enable API access on the GST portal, then start a new session. Do not retry; retrying cannot succeed until the taxpayer acts. | inferred | GST portal, Manage API Access page; GSTN notice not yet found |
| `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` | A GSTN or NIC call timed out; the outcome of a write is unknown (symbolic code). | The upstream (GSTN or NIC) did not answer in time; the request may or may not have been processed. | Treat the outcome as unknown. Reconcile with the status operation (retstatus for returns, GETIRNBYDOCDETAILS for IRN, the e-Way Bill get-by-document or number call for EWB); retry the write only if nothing landed, at least 10 minutes apart, with a cap on attempts and a terminal owner. | inferred | WhiteBooks, confirmed 2026-10-13 |
| `WB_ERR_9000` | Unexpected error (WhiteBooks gateway). | The gateway failed on something it did not classify; the sandbox reply carried only the message. | Retry a read after a short pause. For a write, treat the outcome as unknown and reconcile with the status operation before resending. If it persists, give WhiteBooks the request time and path. | observed | WhiteBooks sandbox, observed 2026-10-13 |
| `WB_ERR_9001` | Invalid credentials, or the WhiteBooks account is not active. | The client id or secret is wrong, or the account is not active. | Check the client_id and client_secret headers against the WhiteBooks account and confirm the account is active; do not retry with the same values. | observed | WhiteBooks sandbox, observed 2026-10-13 |
| `WB_ERR_9101` | Missing mandatory parameters; the status_desc names the parameter, for example 'otp'. | A required query or body parameter is absent from the request. | Add the parameter named in status_desc (the catalog lists each operation's required parameters) and resend. | observed | WhiteBooks sandbox, observed 2026-10-13 |
| `WB_ERR_9104` | Missing mandatory headers. | A header the gateway requires, such as ip_address, client_id, client_secret, username or gstin, is absent. | Send every header the operation requires (see the operation's headers in the catalog) and resend. | observed | WhiteBooks sandbox, observed 2026-10-13 |
| `WB_ERR_9404` | No API configured for the route (route not found). | The path or method does not match a WhiteBooks route, or the API is not configured for the account. | Check the path and method against the catalog; if they match, ask WhiteBooks to enable the API for the account. | observed | WhiteBooks sandbox, observed 2026-10-13 |
